name: Darc Sport

prices.note: Whole store (929 products, 4 pages): only 5 short-sleeve tees at regular price, all one design, Big Wolf Head ($45: Premium Oversized Tee in 3 colors, Grunge Raw Hem Box Cut Tommy Muscle Tee). 196 products (75 of 112 in Men's Tees) carry a compare-at price above price, i.e. marked down; the site runs a 'DARC SUNDAY SALE' section. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final, DiscountApplied, sale-NN, NN%, on-sale, sale, flash-sale, further reductions); campaign-eligibility tags with no compare-at price (e.g. '10th-anniversary-sale', 'cp:SeptEOSSale', 'DISCOUNT') are not treated as markdowns. Short-sleeve tees only: long-sleeve, tanks, stringers, polos, button-ups, jerseys, sweaters, packs and box sets excluded.
